## 4.1.53 (HexGhoul): the gangs' traits and daily quests

HexKagune 4.1.53 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (124); update the server and every client together as usual.

Your words: "Gang Traits: / Aogiri - Wild ghouls no longer attack unless provoked, gain strength when fighting CCG and other gangs. / Noro
gives Daily quests (missions with item rewards such as ores, ghoul meat,  human meat, reputation etc...) / Clowns Traits: / Gain Jump
boost when fighting CCG, kagune, player and armor become fully invisible for 5 seconds when at low HP (5 minute cooldown). / The leader
gives daily quests as well with clown related rewards, and reputation."; and your answer "Joining gives the mask".

**Aogiri Tree's traits** (for a player in Aogiri):
- **Wild ghouls no longer attack you** unless you provoke them (hit them: they still fight back).
- **Strength** (Strength I, 10 seconds, kept up while the fight goes on) whenever you hit, or are hit by, an investigator (or the CCG's
  ghoul division) or a member of another gang (the Clowns, the Gas Masks).

**The Clowns' traits** (for a player in the Clowns):
- **Jump Boost II** (10 seconds, kept up while the fight goes on) whenever you hit, or are hit by, the CCG.
- **Fully invisible for 5 seconds** when your health falls to 30% or under, at most once every 5 minutes: your body, your armour, what you
  hold and your kagune are all hidden, the same way the kakuja's vanish hides everything. "now you see me..." over your hotbar.

**Daily quests:** once a game day, ask your gang's quest giver: **Noro** for Aogiri ("Any work for me today?"), **Roma** for the Clowns
("Got a job for me, boss?"). The option is on their first page, for members only.
- Noro's jobs: kill 3 to 5 investigators; kill 3 to 5 Clowns or Gas Masks; bring him 4 to 8 human meat.
- Roma's jobs: kill 3 to 5 Gas Masks; kill 2 to 4 investigators; bring her 4 to 8 alliums.
- Kills count as you make them, shown over your hotbar ("Daily: Kill 4 investigators (2/4)"). Things to bring: hold them when you talk
  to the giver.
- When it's done, go back: you're paid **two rewards** and **+10% reputation**. Noro pays in raw iron, raw gold, diamonds, emeralds, Ghoul
  Meat or human meat. Roma pays in a cake, fireworks, a clown mask, alliums, Ghoul Meat or gold ingots.
- A new job each game day; an unfinished one is replaced by the next day's.

**Joining gives the mask:** joining Aogiri gives you its rank and file's Laughing Mask, joining the Clowns a clown mask, into your
inventory (dropped at your feet if it's full). Members from 4.1.50 to 4.1.52 get theirs the next time they play.
